title: CanvasXpress portable figure spec
description: JSON Schema for the persisted, portable CanvasXpress figure — the {data, config} object emitted by getConfig()/"Save as JSON" and embedded in the self-describing PNG. This is the primary contract users serialize and the surface the round-trip reproducibility guarantee covers. Versioned 1.0 under the published compatibility policy: additive keys are MINOR and a reader ignores unknown keys, so this schema pins the STRUCTURE and the load-bearing keys and stays open (additionalProperties:true) for the long tail rather than freezing every parameter — strict name validation would break the forward-render guarantee (a 2031 key must not fail a 2026 validator). config carries the full parameter vocabulary (hundreds of keys documented in the parameter reference).

schemaVersion.description: Semver MAJOR.MINOR of the figure contract. NEW field ; absent in specs written before it is introduced — readers must treat a missing value as the pre-1.0 baseline.

data.description: The chart data, accepted in three shapes. (1) Object form: the wide-matrix { y, x, z } spec — this is what getConfig()/"Save as JSON" emits and the canonical persisted shape. (2) Array form: a tabular 2D array (data frame) whose first row is the column header and each subsequent row is a record — the engine converts it to the matrix form internally. (3) String form: either a JSON string of the object/array form (parsed first), or a URL/path to a remote data file that is fetched and parsed by extension — .json (and .pl CGI), .csv/.tsv/.txt/.tab (delimited), .parquet, .png (self-describing PNG), .svg, .gexf/*ml/ml.bz2 (network/XML), and .zip/.tar/.tgz/.tar.gz/.gz archives; a DOM id of an HTML <table class="CanvasXpress"> is also accepted. Non-matrix graph types (network, genome, venn, map) carry their own data shapes under the object form. A serialized figure normally stores the resolved object form, not a URL or string.

oneOf.description: Wide-matrix object form. y is the primary numeric matrix; x annotates samples (columns), z annotates variables (rows).

data.description: Row-major values: data[i][j] for vars[i] x smps[j].

x.description: Per-sample (column) annotations: annotation name -> array parallel to y.smps.

z.description: Per-variable (row) annotations: annotation name -> array parallel to y.vars.

oneOf.description: Tabular data-frame form: a 2D array of rows. The first row is the column header; each subsequent row is a record. Converted to the matrix form internally.

String form: a JSON string of the object/array data, OR a URL/path to a remote data file fetched at load time and parsed by extension (.json/.pl, .csv/.tsv/.txt/.tab, .parquet, .png, .svg, .gexf/*ml/ml.bz2, .zip/.tar/.tgz/.tar.gz/.gz), OR the DOM id of an HTML <table class="CanvasXpress">. Resolved to the object form before rendering.

config.description: Rendering configuration. graphType selects the geometry; the remaining keys are the parameter vocabulary (see https://www.canvasxpress.org/parameters.html). Open by design (additionalProperties:true, as the forward-render guarantee requires) — unknown keys within a MAJOR line are ignored, not fatal.

graphType.description: The chart type, e.g. Scatter2D, Bar, Line, Heatmap, Boxplot, Violin, Network, Genome, Circular, Venn, Treemap, Meter, OptionsWall.

events.description: Optional event handlers (function bodies serialized by name).

afterRender.description: Optional replayable post-render operation list (the audit-trail seed).
